summary: Panel kit 8: drop the old dialog/button sprites the kit replaced
author: client
body:
Spec step 8 (user: "Once everything is rebuilt, drop the old sprites"). Re-run the census (.claude/scratch/panel_kit/regen_proof/sprite_usage.py); drop only fully unused sprites (expected: InterfaceNdButton, InterfaceNdText, maybe Game1); list partly used ones with their remaining users.

Done when: the census shows 0 references for each dropped sprite, the client loads and every dialog draws.
